document_metadata.document_type: Mainframe Batch To .NET 8 Target Design Specification

source_system_summary.processing_description: Validate and post the daily transactions; rejects with reason codes 100-103.

business_rules.statement: A daily transaction whose card number is not in XREF is rejected with reason 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'.
A transaction whose account is missing is rejected with reason 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'.
Credit limit check uses cycle amounts: limit >= cycle credit - cycle debit + amount, else reason 102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'.
Expiry check: account expiration date >= origin date (first 10 chars), else reason 103; 103 overwrites 102 when both fail.
Rejected transactions are written to DALYREJS as the 350-byte record plus an 80-byte trailer (reason 9(4) + description X(76)).
Missing (account, type, category) balance records are created with the transaction amount.
Existing category balances are incremented by the transaction amount.
The amount is added to ACCT-CURR-BAL; non-negative amounts to cycle credit, negative amounts to cycle debit.
Posted transactions get PROC-TS = current DB2-format timestamp.
TRANSACT is opened OUTPUT: the posted-transaction file is replaced by this run's postings.
Return code 4 when at least one transaction was rejected.

gaps.description: Plugin numeric convention prescribes MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero; the legacy source has no ROUNDED and golden fixtures prove truncation (i02-tie-half-cent). Legacy truncation is kept (ADR-003).
